nodes.description: Biallelic variants in IARS2, a nuclear gene. The founding family carried a homozygous missense change at a conserved residue; the Danish patient a different homozygous missense allele, p.Gly874Arg; two Iranian probands further homozygous missense alleles, p.Pro909Ser and p.His761Arg. Compound heterozygous alleles in the same gene were found independently in a patient with a more severe phenotype diagnosed as Leigh syndrome.

genetic_context.description: Recorded UNKNOWN rather than LOSS_OF_FUNCTION on purpose. The founding family's variant reduced IARS2 protein in cultured skin cells, which reads as loss of function, but a later patient's fibroblasts showed unchanged IARS2 levels and normal respiratory chain activity. No aminoacylation assay on any patient allele has been reported, so the functional consequence is inferred from the gene's job rather than measured.

nodes.description:
The step that the intuitive model predicts, and that has been demonstrated - but at the severe end of the IARS2 spectrum rather than in CAGSSS. Lymphocytes from two children with biallelic IARS2 variants and Leigh syndrome showed impaired mitochondrial function from severe complex I and III deficiency, reproduced in IARS2-knockdown HEK293T cells, and re-expressing wild-type but not mutant IARS2 rescued the complex deficiency, oxygen consumption and ATP content.
This node is included because it is the best available account of how an IARS2 defect damages a cell, and it is marked INDIRECT for this entry throughout because the alleles tested cause Leigh syndrome, not CAGSSS, and the one CAGSSS-range patient assayed the same way had normal respiratory chain activity.

nodes.description: Curated principally as a failure, because that is the informative part. One patient's graft was rejected at 30, and the most fully described adult was referred with multiple failed grafts and severe eye dryness. That pattern is mechanistically coherent rather than bad luck: a cornea denervated by the syndrome's sensory neuropathy does not heal, which is what neurotrophic keratitis means, and grafting into it repeats the problem. A CAGSSS patient facing corneal grafting should be counselled with that in front of them.

nodes.description: IARS2 is a nuclear-encoded, highly conserved enzyme that charges mitochondrial tRNA with its cognate amino acid for translation. A defect here degrades the supply of charged tRNA-Ile to the mitochondrial ribosome, so the affected process is mitochondrial protein synthesis as a whole rather than any one respiratory complex. Note that no patient allele has had its aminoacylation activity measured; this node states the enzyme's established role and the class of defect a pathogenic variant in it produces.

nodes.description: The clinical layer. The tissues affected span lens, anterior pituitary, cochlea, peripheral sensory nerve and the developing skeleton, with adrenal and oesophageal involvement reported in adults. Features do not appear together: the skeletal dysplasia can be present at birth while cataract, neuropathy and hearing loss emerge over years.

nodes.description: Congenital neurotrophic keratitis, reported in an adult with the full CAGSSS pentad who presented with multiple failed corneal grafts and severe eye dryness. It is the ocular counterpart of the sensory neuropathy - a cornea that has lost its trigeminal sensory supply does not heal - which makes it mechanistically coherent with the rest of the syndrome rather than an incidental finding.
